title: Glimpsed classified UAP photos via colleagues

tellings.quote: so I began to see all sorts of stuff I told you about earlier photos and other things that said UAP are here

plain: Bob McGwier, introduced on the show as a CIA contractor, says that through colleagues in classified government settings he got glimpses of secret photos and other material on UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs. He tells Michels he saw it himself: "I began to see all sorts of stuff I told you about earlier photos and other things that said UAP are here." If true, the government holds images that point to such things being real.
